Messages.Body:
cam up during last night game. please let me know what is right or
wrong about this.

a) player has vamp in torpor. decides not to diablrise it.
b) during his influence phase he brings out a second copy of the
vampire in torpor.
c) he now contests his own vampires

and this is when we have problems... does he know do the following?

version1
d) gets back to his turn, he pays 0 pool for the contest and gives up
the vamp in torpor
e) gets to his influence phase and get his vampire back

version 2
d) gets back to his turn, he pays 1 pool for the contest and gives up
the vamp in torpor
e) gets to his influence phase and get his vampire back

version 3
d) gets back to his turn, he pays 0 pool for the contest and gives up
the vamp in torpor
e) end of his go, his vamp is still face down
f) start of his next turn he gets his vampire back

version 4
d) gets back to his turn, he pays 1 pool for the contest and gives up
the vamp in torpor
e) end of his go, his vamp is still face down
f) start of his next turn he gets his vampire back

version 5
d) gets back to his turn, he pays 0 pool for the contest and gives up
the vamp in torpor
e) end of his go, his vamp is still face down
f) in his next turn, during his influence phase he gets his vampire
back

version 4
d) gets back to his turn, he pays 1 pool for the contest and gives up
the vamp in torpor
e) end of his go, his vamp is still face down
f) in his next turn, during his influence phase he gets his vampire
back

help. we know this has been errated but we're still not sure as to
whats supposed to happen. we went with version 4 but would appreciate
confirmation thats the right one.

many thanks

anam

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
stubby wrote:
> [Methuselah brings out a second copy of her own vampire, contesting herself]

>
> version 4
> d) gets back to his turn, he pays 1 pool for the contest and gives up
> the vamp in torpor
> e) end of his go, his vamp is still face down
> f) start of his next turn he gets his vampire back
>

> help. we know this has been errated but we're still not sure as to
> whats supposed to happen. we went with version 4 but would appreciate
> confirmation thats the right one.

Confirmed.

No errata has ever been issued on this subject, so the rulebook rules hold.
[4.1] of the revised rulebook, or V:TES printed rulebook [15], or Jyhad
printed rulebook [8].

Contests are "resolved" during the next untap phase (not influence phase)
after all but one copy of the contested card has been yielded. While
contesting, a Methuselah must pay one pool to continue the contest or yield.
